text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Phew, this is the place. Finally made it.
Now to carry ST-2 inside...
choice_data_list: Dr. Lights!? Why are you at the training camp?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what? If I didn't come,
how could we possibly upgrade ST-2?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: While we're at it, I'll also help strengthen the training equipment <chrname> will be using during the training camp.

A surprise guest. What's more, I'm really grateful
for the help, but...
choice_data_list: Why would you go that far for me?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Why, huh...?
Even if you ask me that...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know... I guess you could call it repaying the favor.
Though it's not really big enough to call it that...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: "Regardless, don't worry about it. I only came because I wanted to. It's not... a nuisance, is it?"
choice_data_list: Of course! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.text: I nod with a smile. It felt as though I'd gained a dependable ally for the summer.
